name: Nial
title: Pinewatch Stores
examine: Iron, rope, resin and salve, arranged so the salve is nearest the door. He knows which one you came in for.
lines: Salve is by the door for a reason. Second week is when the hands go.
Rope I can get. Good rope comes up from Saltmere and takes a month.
I keep two of everything and three of the things people lose.
